definitions.explanation: Involving bloodshed and killing, said of events, history and stories. Literally 'smelling of blood', and occasionally used of that smell.

examples.japanese: {血|ち}なまぐさい⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧。
⟦{戦国時代|せんごくじだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{血|ち}なまぐさい⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The Warring States period saw one bloody conflict after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{血|ち}なまぐさい⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{勧|すす}められない→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: That film has a lot of gory scenes, so I can't recommend it for children.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血|ち}なまぐさい⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: a bloody incident
- {血|ち}なまぐさい⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: a bloody struggle
- {血|ち}なまぐさい⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧: a bloody history

WRITING:
Also written {血生臭|ちなまぐさ}い. ⟦{生臭|なまぐさ}い→生臭い：06822_namagusai⟧ alone means "smelling of raw fish or meat."

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {血|ち}なまぐさくなかったら
